A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Cluster-PC and Cluster-FCI research. All 23 pages, including figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–D, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports four original simulation studies, with outcomes in Section 4, Figures 3–4, Tables 1–2 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the four original simulation studies and their reported outcomes in the main text and Appendix B.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–4 retain the same graph initialization, pruning, conditional-independence testing and orientation procedures. Cluster-PC and Cluster-FCI receive no procedural or component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same four synthetic causal-discovery scenarios, including fully and partially observed settings, the same graph families, and Gaussian, exponential and Gumbel distributions.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: PC in Simulations 1–2, FCI and FCITiers in Simulations 3–4, and the empty-graph SHD reference in Figure 4.

E3.justification: Table 3 retains the same graph counts, sample sizes, graph sizes, Fisher-z tests and significance levels. Evaluation metrics and the DAG-first/C-DAG-first generation procedures also match.

E4.justification: Section 4, Figures 3–4 and Appendix B retain the same sensitivity analyses concerning significance levels, cluster counts, graph density, graph generators and probability distributions.

E5.justification: Table 3 retains 10, 1, 10 and 5 runs per configuration for Simulations 1–4. Seed disclosure and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Reported values and trends in Figures 3–4 and Tables 1, 2, 4 and 5 match. For example, Simulation 1 adjacency F1 remains 55.3% for PC and 62.7% for Cluster-PC.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, theorems, proofs and mathematical formulations are unchanged, including Appendices A, C and D. Expanding proof abbreviations and updating citation dates do not revise the reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims about C-DAG flexibility, Cluster-PC soundness and completeness, Cluster-FCI soundness and incompleteness, and simulation performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of CI-test savings and precision–recall tradeoffs remain unchanged. The discussion of ancestrality, Cluster-FCI incompleteness, excluded selection variables and future directions is retained.

D1.justification: The experiment code link, Table 3 hyperparameters and Appendix B.3 graph-generation instructions are unchanged. No implementation or computational-resource details are added.

R1.justification: Section 1.1 replaces the single-author Yvernes note on cyclic Cluster-DAGs with Yvernes et al.'s work on relaxing partition admissibility. Most other reference edits update publication metadata for existing works; the research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds affiliations and a funding acknowledgment, corrects several typos, expands 'W.l.o.g.' in proofs and updates bibliographic metadata. The narrative and section organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author block and bibliography reflow text and appendix pages. Table 3 moves from page 20 to page 21, after Table 4. Figures and table designs are retained, with minor citation updates in Figure 5's caption.

improvement.justification: Fuller publication references, added funding attribution and wording corrections modestly improve documentation and polish. Table 3's placement after Table 4 introduces a small navigation drawback. The methods, proofs and empirical evidence remain unchanged, keeping the overall gain limited.
